brief: The combined duration of all native module calls in the flushed call aggregate, in milliseconds. Only applies to React Native.

deprecation.reason: Replaced by the `react_native.module.*` namespace; the SDK emitted the same values under both a singular `turbo_module.*` and a plural `turbo_modules.*` prefix

changelog.description: Added turbo_modules.total_duration_ms and deprecated it in favor of react_native.module.duration.total
